name: Accredited Limousine Service
description: Chauffeured car service from Rye Brook, NY for Westchester, Connecticut and NYC. Airport transfers, corporate travel and weddings.
faqs: How do I request a quote?
You can request a quote by contacting us through our website or by phone at 914-725-9444. Provide your trip details including pickup location, destination, date and time, and number of passengers.
How far in advance should I book?
We recommend booking as early as possible, especially for weddings, corporate events and airport transfers during peak travel times. However, we also accommodate last-minute requests 24/7.
Are you available 24 hours a day?
Yes. Accredited Limo is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, 365 days a year.
Yes. We provide transportation to JFK, LaGuardia, Newark, Teterboro and Westchester County Airport with flight tracking and meet-and-greet service.
Do you offer transportation for corporate events?
Yes. We provide professional transportation for corporate travel, meetings, roadshows and events with dedicated dispatch support.
What types of vehicles do you have?
Our fleet includes 2026 Lincoln Aviators, 2025 Volvo S90 sedans, 2025 Chevrolet Suburbans, Mercedes-Benz Sprinter vans, and minibuses and motor coaches for groups up to 56 passengers.
We serve Westchester County, Fairfield County CT, Putnam County NY, and Manhattan, with airport service to all major NYC-area airports.
Call us at 914-725-9444 or toll-free 888-444-3108, email reservations@accreditedlimo.com, or book online at book.mylimobiz.com/v4/als
